sensor: Thermal: MCT cooled focal plane array, 640x512, 15 um pixel pitch, 3.7-4.8 um, NETD <= 25 mK; optical: 1/1.8in Progressive Scan CMOS, 4 MP

storage.notes: microSD/SDHC/SDXC up to 1 TB; NAS (NFS, SMB/CIFS); ANR

features: Bi-spectrum cooled thermal sphere PTZ (positioning system)
MCT cooled focal plane array detector, 640x512, 15 um pixel pitch, NETD <= 25 mK
Thermal spectral range 3.7 to 4.8 um for long-range detection through haze/fog
Thermal lens 21 to 510 mm motorized zoom, F4.0, auto focus
Optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), fixed lens 4 mm plus PTZ lens 10-1100 mm
Optical Image Stabilization (OIS) on optical channel, EIS on thermal channel
Perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance and exit
Ship detection and ship VCA in thermal channel
Heating and de-icing for low-temperature environment
External GPS module via RS-485 for coordinates
Thermal DORI: human detection 13.3 km, recognition 3.9 km, identification 2.7 km
Audio in/out (3.5 mm mic/line in, line out), 2 alarm inputs, 2 relay outputs

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical channel is Channel 1 (101/102), thermal channel is Channel 2 (201). Positioning/PTZ movement over ONVIF.

release_notes: HikMicro bi-spectrum cooled thermal sphere PTZ for long-range perimeter and coastal/critical-infrastructure surveillance. This variant pairs a 21-510 mm motorized thermal zoom with a 4 MP optical PTZ channel.
